text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from going out 
together—Neo Universe suddenly stops in 
her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Neo Universe wants to 
"attempt" "Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors."
choice_data_list: Huh? W-What's got into you all of ...
Huh? W-What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital's "statement"—
choice_data_list: Huh? W-what's with you all of a su...
Huh? W-what's with you all of a su...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors is a staple 
for the walk home." That's why I want to 
do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Since she showed interest, I would love 
to make it happen. However, this game is 
much more fun with more people."
choice_data_list: In that case, let's invite someone...

text_block_list.text:
Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors! Now that 
sounds interesting.
choice_data_list: In that case, why don't we invite ...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I heard about it from the friends I made 
over here. Hey, Mirako, let's go join 
them!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aha, sure thing~ We finished shopping for 
the dorm anyway. Man, rock-paper-scissors 
for carrots brings back memories.
choice_data_list: Thanks! Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors! One, two, 
shoot!
choice_data_list: Thanks! Well then, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—"Paper." That makes it Neo Universe's 
"victory," right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
P-I-N-E-A-P-P-L-E— With this,
Neo Universe 
is in the 'lead'.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: All right, let's keep going! Rock, paper—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“—The optimal solution is a Nash 
equilibrium. If I 'derive' it from action 
probabilities, the next move is...”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Pon! ――What the hell? Did Universe sweep 
the board all by herself again?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, dead last is Trainer-san, huh? You 
fell waaaay behind, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, lost by about 30 meters, huh? Now 
that's a refreshingly total defeat!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, you've got me beat~!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Ahaha, boy, you've got me beat!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... are you... "happy"...? Even 
though... the outcome was "defeat"...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, even so, the gap is only widening, 
huh. Shall we apply a handicap soon?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty~ Starting now, whenever there's 
a tie, only the person in last place gets 
to move forward!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!!
choice_data_list: It's a tie! Car-rot-stick!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! You've caught up quite a bit.
choice_data_list: It's a tie! Carrot!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Distance to Neo Universe: 3m... That's a 
'breakthrough.'"
choice_data_list: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...? In my chest, an increase in 
'values'...?
An unknown sensation has been 
'detected'..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is the relief measure. 
Well, the match could go anywhere now, so 
that makes it pretty fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Plus, it kinda feels cozy, 
y'know? Like everyone's just having a 
blast hanging out together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...! 'Warm'... So this is what it feels 
like...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"All right,
we made it! That was one fiery 
dead heat!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Man, it's been a while since I've 
had that much fun.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Exercise level: below "normal." But...
the 
"warmth" is still lingering...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: What is... this...?
choice_data_list: I think that's what "having fun" r...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: I think that's what 'having fun' i...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you become "fun"? Are you... 
"warm"...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, hanging out with you is fun,...
Yeah, playing with Universe is so ...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Yeah, hanging out with Universe is...
Yeah, playing with Universe is fun.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Fun" is... still "dark matter." 
However... it is the same for Neo 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Warm"... "Fun"... Just like everyone 
else.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Contact"... established.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe savors the taste slowly. I 
wonder if I was able to give her a little 
taste of "a child's warm, universal 
memories."
choice_data_list: The winner deserves a prize, huh.
The winner deserves a prize, doesn...
Let's make lots of memories like t...
After we play, it's snack time.
After we play, let's have a snack,...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe savors the taste slowly. I 
wonder if I was able to give her a little 
taste of "a child's warm, universal 
memories."
choice_data_list: The winner deserves a prize, huh.
The winner deserves a prize, right?
Let's make lots of memories like t...
Snack time comes after playtime.
Snack time comes after playtime.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! I think you treated me 
to some snacks or something~!
choice_data_list: The winner deserves a prize, huh.
The winner deserves a prize, right?
Let's make lots of memories like t...
Snack time comes after playtime.
Snack time comes after playtime.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Universe-chan came in first place today 
after all. I've gotta present a proper 
tribute to her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: And so, here are some sweets from me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I shall grant you some bread!
choice_data_list: Juice from me!
Juice from me!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Sfera. This is... "precious," isn't it?
choice_data_list: And from me, some juice!
Juice from me!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. I want to... "make memories."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then next time, maybe I'll teach you how 
we play outside in America! And after 
that, it's a serious showdown!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—! A "serious duel"... This is 
"communication" too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
First is hopscotch! The plaza sounds 
great, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, we spent the whole time playing 
outside until the sun had completely set.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having a snack after tiring themselves
out 
playing outside is a classic staple for 
kids.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good~. I know a great okonomiyaki 
place to recommend~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, it's insanely delicious. Since 
we're all here, let's eat together~

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Sharing" "recommendations"... That is 
very sphi-ra.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the four of us went to an 
okonomiyaki restaurant—
and shared a taste 
of Hishi Miracle's fond memories.
